title: Decentralised Identifier-Anchored Verifiable Credentials with On-Chain Revocation for Social Media Identity Management
description:
Reference implementation for the paper "Decentralised Identifier-Anchored Verifiable Credentials with On-Chain Revocation for Social Media Identity Management".

It contains:
- an Ethereum registry of DID documents with per-credential revocation keyed by the issuer DID (Solidity);
- a Node.js service that issues W3C Verifiable Credentials with eddsa-jcs-2022 proofs (Ed25519, Multikey);
- a verifier that checks a credential against the registry, with all reads pinned to one block;
- the scripts, logs and tools behind the paper's measurements.

Changes in version 1.1.1:
- the full manifest of the run-day rule files (run_day/RUN_DAY_MANIFEST.sha256, SHA-256 8a2ff62b04a01042e8a523a240eda58d3eb183841b46d8eb1c40803a9d22e04f) is published, so its hash can be recomputed and 21 of its 23 entries checked against published files;
- the figure sources were redesigned and the figure build script checks its tools;
- FROZEN_CODE.sha256 gives the SHA-256 of the nine measurement files at the freeze commit 73b4cca16e7c;
- the README maps each table and figure of the paper to a command, an output and a runtime, lists the files that must not change, and states further limits, the dependency audit and the licence;
- citation metadata for version 1.1.1.
The contract, the code, the tests (164) and the published logs are those of version 1.1.0.

Data and run records:
The measurement code was frozen at commit 73b4cca16e7c before the Sepolia run of 12 November 2026. Added after the run, without changing that code:
- the timed local log of 9 November 2026;
- the closed Sepolia log of 12 November 2026;
- the v1.1.0 deployment record (contract 0x625eD772F70199BAc1A33A3BAF49B7394bBb5FC2 on Sepolia);
- the output of the unchanged earlier test and the log of the revised harness on the earlier code;
- the run-day rules (the pre-registration addendum and the run tools) with the manifest lines of the published files and the full manifest;
- the run checker and its tests, the final verdict and the analysis output;
- a sanitised summary of the network monitor;
- the figure scripts;
- the transcript of the test run at the archived commit.

The raw monitor and wrapper logs remain with the authors. README.md explains how to reproduce the paper's numbers and figures.

Version 1.1.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24263442) has the same contract, code, tests and logs. Version 1.0.0 (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.21515958) is superseded.
